summary: 40 proposals judged: 30 PASS, 10 FAIL (75%). No quote was fabricated; one evidence item mixes a reader's gloss into a quote (Entry Conatus to Spore Check, the parenthetical), one cites the wrong line (Palace Enchantment :865 for :853), and one is a paraphrase with a line range (Swarm Weave). The failures follow one pattern: the readers searched the two pages' bodies for each other's titles and stopped there. The reasons they missed sit in a Context file (Pages as Agents to Lateral Access, SCHEMA's agency_profile origin), in SUBSTRATE's anatomy JSON (Endosymbiosis, Image Embedding Standard), on the target side (Spore Check names the Weave as the one that deletes), or in a sentence that states the relation without naming the page (Biomechanical Synthesis to Granular Synthesis and to Frequency-Time Duality, Progressive Staging's open question). Two retypes chose a direction the pages do not settle (Pages as Agents deepens JEWEL, when Jewel — Context records the line grew from it; Four Pillars of Enchanted Agency deepens Swarm Weave, when it elaborates the forward_vector, not the Weave). One label rests on a sentence its own ceremony has retired (Map Build's post-harvest map, struck in v2.6). The readers also claim reverse links that do not exist five times (Spore Check to Weave, Palace Ceremonies to Baton and to Return, BBS Blackboard to Palace Map, Four Pillars of Enchanted Agency to SCHEMA): the 'drop the other side' instructions would act on nothing, and the Weave to Spore Check cut would leave that pair with no link at all. They may have been reading a map that lists edges both ways. Surfaces and Capabilities.md was missing from the worktree while I read it.
